lines.text: BLUE: Congrats, kid!\c\nBoy, though, what a shock...

I never thought a criminal would use
a Pokémon Gym as their hideout...
... ... ...\c
That’s it! I’ve decided!

I’ll look after the Viridian City Gym from now on!\c
I don’t really like to get tied down, so I’ve
always said no when they ask about it, but...\c
I’m finally ready.
I’ll be the Gym Leader from now on.

Thanks!\c
With an awesome Trainer like me around, I’m
pretty sure the Kanto region’ll be safe from
troublemakers like Team Rocket forever!
Huh? I mean, sure, but I think you’ve got\na bigger challenge to face right now.

So then, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]...
Time for you to take on the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pokémon League[VAR COLOR(0000)]!\c
Just keep going along Route 22 to the west of
here, and you won’t miss it.\c
The Elite Four are tough opponents, but
don’t you dare lose!
BLUE: The first challenger I’ll have here...\nI’m sure it’s gonna be [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!\c\nI’m gonna show that little upstart how it’s done!
